findings.issue: מְלֶאכֶת הַקֹּדֶשׁ is a construct of the common noun H6944 (holiness). “del santo” makes that noun a holy person or saint.
Uncertain lexical fit: “balanceo” can mean rocking or balancing, which may shift the noun H8573 away from waving or swinging.

notes: The amounts, singular שֶׁקֶל, and the second הַקֹּדֶשׁ as “santidad” match the tokens.
